import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f9e7d5aa.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Reverse the color order of nested, solid rectangular bands by replacing
    # each object's distinct colors with the reverse of its outer-to-inner list.
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=g[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            cells=[]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]!=0:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            # components may be joined by edge-touching; derive nested layers by
            # distinct colors in order of their bounding-box perimeter.
            vals=[]
            for y,x in cells:
                if g[y][x] not in vals: vals.append(g[y][x])
            # For rectangular nested bands, layer colors appear outer to inner
            # in row-major discovery; instead sort by first occurrence from edges.
            y0=min(y for y,x in cells); y1=max(y for y,x in cells); x0=min(x for y,x in cells); x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            layers=[]
            for d in range(min((y1-y0+1)//2+1,(x1-x0+1)//2+1)):
                samples=[g[y0+d][x] for x in range(x0+d,x1-d+1)]+[g[y][x0+d] for y in range(y0+d,y1-d+1)]
                col=next((v for v in samples if v!=0),None)
                if col is not None and col not in layers: layers.append(col)
            if len(layers)>1:
                mp=dict(zip(layers,layers[::-1]))
                for y,x in cells: g[y][x]=mp.get(g[y][x],g[y][x])
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
